dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: In lofty flight doth Mandarin ducks soar, swimming 'neath the sun, their freedom they adore.

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: The turtles betwixt water columns doth glide, catfish in schools, together they bide.

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: The souls of the land, o'er mountain and swamp, creep through the bushes, their spirits to romp.

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: Bishui is wide and mighty, yet a tortoise it spans, crossing with ease, as one snapper can.

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: Surveying the world, inspiration doth unfold, sorrow yet smolders within, like tales of old.

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: The bridge still stands firm, as do boats on the wave, swaying in the wind, lonesome if brave.

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: Offerings of meat, a hopeful display, nourishing companions, as I wait and pray.

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: Freely I offer victuals, a feast to extend, friends partake, in providence, we blend.
